India: Government Schemes & State-wise Data 2025–26

Central + State Schemes · Economic Indicators · Political Data · IPM PYQ Reference · All 28 States + 8 UTs

🏛️ Major Central Government Schemes (Active 2025–26)

Agriculture

PM-KISAN

₹6,000/yr direct income support to landholding farmer families in 3 instalments. ~11 crore beneficiaries. Source: PM-KISAN portal, MoAFW

Agriculture

PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)

Crop insurance at subsidised premium (2% kharif, 1.5% rabi). Covers post-harvest, localised risks. Renamed/revamped 2022. Source: MoAFW

Agriculture

e-NAM (National Agri Market)

Online trading platform linking 1,361+ APMCs across 23 states. Transparent price discovery for farmers. Source: SFAC, 2024

Health

Ayushman Bharat – PM-JAY

World's largest health insurance: ₹5 lakh/family/year for 55 crore+ beneficiaries. Expanded to all seniors 70+ in 2024. Source: NHA

Health

National Health Mission (NHM)

Strengthens public health infra in rural & urban areas. Sub-missions: NRHM + NUHM. Source: MoHFW

Infrastructure

PM Awas Yojana (PMAY)

Housing for All: 2.95 crore houses sanctioned under PMAY-Gramin; urban target 1.18 crore. Extended to 2027. Source: MoHUA, MoRD

Infrastructure

PM Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)

All-weather roads to rural habitations. Phase-IV: 25,000 km target (2024–29). Source: MoRD

Infrastructure

Jal Jeevan Mission

Tap water to every rural household by 2024 (deadline extended). 15.08 crore connections as of 2025. Source: DJM, MoJS

Infrastructure

PM SVANidhi

Micro-credit for street vendors: ₹10K → ₹20K → ₹50K loans. Digital transaction incentives. ~55 lakh vendors covered. Source: MoHUA

Finance

PM Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)

Financial inclusion: 53+ crore accounts, ₹2 lakh accident insurance, RuPay debit card. Source: DFS, MoF, 2025

Finance

Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)

Collateral-free loans for non-corporate SMEs: Shishu (≤₹50K), Kishore (₹50K–5L), Tarun (₹5L–10L). Tarun+ up to ₹20L. Source: MUDRA, MoF

Finance

Atal Pension Yojana (APY)

Guaranteed pension (₹1K–5K/month) for unorganised sector workers 18–40 yrs. 7.3 crore subscribers (2025). Source: PFRDA

Women & Children

Beti Bachao Beti Padhao

Addresses declining Child Sex Ratio; educational interventions; covers 640+ districts. Source: MoWCD

Women & Children

PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)

₹5,000 maternity benefit to first-time mothers; ₹6,000 for second child if girl. DBT. Source: MoWCD

Digital

Digital India

BharatNet (rural broadband), Umang App, DigiLocker, Common Service Centres (CSCs). Source: MeitY

Digital

PM e-Vidya / NEP 2020

One Nation One Digital Infrastructure for education. SWAYAM, DIKSHA portals. Source: MoE

Education

PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal)

Hot cooked meals in govt schools Cl. 1–8 + pre-primary. 12 crore+ children daily. Source: MoE

Education

Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan

Unified scheme covering pre-school to Class XII; integrates SSA, RMSA, TE. Source: MoE, 2025

Rural Dev

MGNREGA

Legal guarantee: 100 days/yr wage employment to rural households. ~9 crore active job cards. Source: MoRD, 2025

Defence/Security

Agnipath Scheme (Agniveer)

Short-term (4-yr) military recruitment; 25% retention. ₹11–21L Seva Nidhi on exit. Controversial; active since 2022. Source: MoD

Energy

PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli

Rooftop solar for 1 crore households; 300 units free electricity/month. Launched 2024. Source: MNRE

MSME

PLI (Production Linked Incentive)

14 sectors (mobile, pharma, auto, textiles, food processing…); ₹1.97 lakh cr outlay. Boost to Make in India. Source: DPIIT

Nutrition

POSHAN 2.0

Merges ICDS, Annapoorna, POSHAN Abhiyan, NHM nutrition. Targets stunting, wasting, anaemia. Source: MoWCD

Startup

Startup India / Fund of Funds

10,000 cr FoF via SIDBI; tax exemptions, patent support, DPIIT recognition portal. 1.5 lakh+ startups. Source: DPIIT

📌 Data Sources & Notes: Population data from Census 2011 (projected 2026 estimates added); GDP from MOSPI/CSO State Accounts 2023-24; Inflation from RBI/MOSPI CPI 2024-25; Sex Ratio from NFHS-5 (2019-21) or Census 2011; Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha seats as per Delimitation 2008 + 91st Amendment; Area from Census; Districts verified from state govt sources (post-2024 reorganisations noted). PYQs sourced from IPM Interview Transcripts 2025.

Key PYQ Economics: India calculates GDP using Expenditure + Income method (MOSPI). GDP types: nominal vs real. India uses GVA at basic prices + taxes - subsidies = GDP. GDP calculated by Central Statistics Office (CSO), now MOSPI. Last census: 2011 (Census 2021 delayed; likely 2025-26).
